Sometime after [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]], a rough-looking '''[[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] referee''' judged [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop races]] in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]]. During a race between [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Drako]], the Gotal was replaced by a [[Unidentified Hawkbat Gang member|Hawkbat Gang member]].<ref name="AA" />
